about_the_game:
Bacteria and viruses have infiltrated our body!

As the player, you become an immune cell tasked with eliminating these invaders. However, fighting alone won't be enough. The scale of the approaching enemies is unimaginable, and increasingly powerful and diverse viruses and bacteria continue to swarm in.

'Supremmune' — Step into the role of an immune cell and guide it to become the strongest cell with the best immunity! Each type of cell has unique abilities, and understanding their characteristics to maximize their strengths and compensate for weaknesses is key to your strategy.

Defeat enemies and collect 'DNA Information' to purchase powerful upgrades and weapons. The evolutionary path offers a wide range of unpredictable routes, so careful decision-making is crucial when selecting items at every step. Sometimes luck will test you, and other times misfortune, but in the end, survival is what matters.

Once you’ve evolved into a powerful immune cell, you’ll be able to defeat enemies in various ways. Whether through simple tactics or occasionally using outlandish strategies, defeat foes, take down bosses, and achieve your ultimate goal. Challenge yourself to rise to the top and become the greatest cell in the ever-changing battlefield!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10+
  • Processor: 2 Ghz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 128MB
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

short_description: Supremmune is a top-down arena game where you play as an immune cell fighting off bacteria and viruses. Earn DNA from battles to buy weapons and items, enhancing each cell's abilities. Make strategic choices to survive unexpected challenges. Evolve into a powerful cell, defeat enemies, and win!
